senses: to put to flight, drive away

strongs.def: compare the base of G1169 (δειλός) and G1249 (διάκονος)); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute
strongs.kjv: ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward
strongs.from: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb (to flee
